title: Migrate to new $gnars
subtitle: One home for $gnars on Clanker. Consolidate your scattered Zora coins into the deposit currency, deposit into the migration, and claim your new $gnars after launch. Enter with ETH (recommended) or bring your old $gnars.
connectPrompt: Connect your wallet to see your Zora coins and enter the migration.

guide.title: How the migration works
guide.intro: This is a batch swap + presale, not a public swap tool. Two ways in: bring fresh ETH (the real backing for the new token), or convert your scattered Zora dust. Both deposit into the migration, and at launch everyone buys the new $gnars together at one shared price.

steps.title: Consolidate or bring ETH
steps.body: Batch-select your scattered Zora content/creator coins — we route them into ETH (recommended) or old $gnars. Fresh ETH is the strongest contribution: it becomes real liquidity backing the new token, which scattered dust can't provide.

steps.title: Deposit into the migration
steps.body: Your ETH (or old $gnars) goes straight into the Upgrader (0x999C…3c7e) — nothing lands loose in your wallet, so the only way out is claiming new $gnars. Watch the official Gnars channels for the open date.

steps.title: One batch buy at launch (TGE)
steps.body: In a single transaction every deposit is sold, the new $gnars is deployed on Clanker (ETH-paired), and everyone buys in at the same snipe-proof price — no preview until launch params are locked.

steps.title: Claim your new $gnars
steps.body: After the batch runs, claim your new $gnars — allocated pro-rata to what you contributed. That's the token going forward: ETH ↔ $gnars ↔ content coins. Vesting: 7 days.

guide.footnote: The ETH lane is what gives the new token real backing — migrating dust is optional and mostly symbolic. Params (to confirm with the operator): 1% swap fee · 30% to treasury · 7-day vesting. Amounts depend on live liquidity and can change; always verify links in official Gnars channels.

route.title: Migration route
route.hopHint: Each coin routes through its pool pairing. The swap happens in one trade — these are the hops under the hood.

preview.title: Consolidation preview
preview.readiesDeposit: This consolidates into your wallet — your deposit currency, ready for the migration deposit below.
preview.slippageWarning: Thin pools move the price on large sells — estimates include slippage and can change before the transaction confirms.
preview.ethPreferred: ETH is the recommended lane: it sells ~1:1 and avoids the thin-pool partial fills that can leave part of a token stuck.
preview.executionNote: Runs one swap per coin — approve each in your wallet. Tip: test with a single low-value coin first.

deposit.title: Deposit into the migration
deposit.gatedHint: The deposit window opens once the operator schedules the upgrade. Consolidate now so you're ready — depositing turns on here the moment it's live.
how: Your ETH (or old $gnars) goes straight into the Upgrader — no loose funds in your wallet.
At launch (TGE) every deposit is sold in one batch buy at a single shared price.
You claim new $gnars here, pro-rata to your share of the deposits.
deposit.partialFillWarning: Thin-pool deposits can partially fill — part of the token may be left with the operator. This is why ETH is the recommended lane.
deposit.claimHint: Available after the operator runs the batch at launch.

editorial.body: Fragmented Zora dust becomes one deep, WETH-paired $gnars on Clanker — with everyone entering at the same price through the migration.

smart.title: Smart deposit plan
smart.hint: We quote every coin and route each to its best deposit currency — old $gnars where it routes, ETH otherwise, and we skip coins with no route.
